verdict.rationale: Logseq is described as privacy-first and offline-first, and users note that data stays local, which keeps it on the user's own device rather than in a vendor cloud. However, no doc shows a user choosing a storage location or region, and Logseq Sync (end-to-end encrypted) has no documented region or residency selection. GitHub syncing is a user workaround, and one user says self-hosting notes on their own server is still only an open feature request. missing for 10: documented choice of storage location or folder, region/residency selection for Logseq Sync, a first-party self-hosted storage option, independent corroboration.
